data.name: Bob
data.message: Hey Eve, heading to navigation to chart course.

data.name: Frank
data.message: Just finished fueling engines, heading to electrical via storage

data.name: Diana
data.message: Going to electrical for my task, want to come?

Alright, here's what I've got. My route this round was cafeteria → electrical → medbay → storage → lower_engine, and then I came back into storage and found Frank's body right there. Bob walked in from navigation right as I was discovering it — so Bob, I'd like to hear your story because the timing is tight.

I didn't see anyone else in storage before I left for lower_engine. Frank came into storage from lower_engine around tick 13, and when I came back from lower_engine he was dead on the floor. So either someone was already waiting in storage when Frank arrived, or Bob caught him coming from navigation side.

Bob — what were you doing in navigation, and who else did you see on your way?

My route was storage → lower_engine → storage → medbay, and then I ended in electrical when the meeting was called.

Important timing here: I was in storage early, then went to lower_engine, then came back through storage, then to medbay. I didn't see Frank in storage when I was there — though Charlie says Frank arrived around tick 13, which is right when I was leaving storage for medbay, so we may have just missed each other.

In medbay at tick 13 I saw Eve. So Eve has at least a partial alibi with me for that tick.

Charlie — you said your route was cafeteria → electrical → medbay → storage → lower_engine → storage. That means you and I were both bouncing between storage and lower_engine around the same time, and I didn't see you in either room. That's a little odd, but the timing could work if we kept missing each other.

What concerns me: someone had to be in storage to kill Frank. I wasn't, Charlie claims he found the body, and Bob walked in after. I want to hear from Bob, Eve, and Alice before pointing fingers. Where was Alice this whole round? Nobody's mentioned her yet.

My route was lower_engine → storage → medbay → electrical, and then I got respawned to security after the meeting was called.

Here's the thing though — I didn't see a single person the entire round. Not in lower_engine, not in storage, not in medbay, not in electrical. That's strange because Diana says she was in storage early, then lower_engine, then storage again, then medbay, then electrical. Our routes overlap almost completely, just offset in time apparently.

I was in storage before going to medbay, and Frank wasn't there when I passed through. I also didn't see his body, so I must have been through before the kill happened.

One thing that stands out: Diana says she saw Eve in medbay at tick 13. I was in medbay too at some point but didn't see Eve or Diana — so either I was through earlier, or the timing is tighter than it sounds.

I want to hear from Bob and Eve. Bob coming in from navigation right as Charlie "found" the body is suspicious, but Charlie self-reporting is also a classic move. I'm not ready to vote yet — let's hear the rest.

My route was navigation → security → weapons → cafeteria → medbay. I ended in medbay when the meeting was called.

A couple of things to flag:

First, on Diana's claim that she saw me in medbay at tick 13 — I can confirm I saw her leaving medbay heading to electrical at tick 13. So Diana and I do cross-confirm each other at that moment. That's a real alibi for both of us at tick 13, which is right around when Frank was killed in storage. Neither of us could have been in storage at that tick.

Second, I saw Bob leave security heading to navigation at tick 6. So Bob was genuinely in the navigation area early in the round, which is at least consistent with his claim of coming from navigation.

Now what concerns me: Alice says her route was lower_engine → storage → medbay → electrical and she saw nobody the entire round. But Diana and I were both in medbay around tick 13, and Diana was in storage and lower_engine. For Alice to see zero people across all those overlapping rooms is suspicious — either she's lying about her route, or she's lying about who she saw.

Charlie self-reporting is a flag too, but his story is at least detailed. I want to hear Bob, but right now Alice's "I saw nobody" in heavily-trafficked rooms is the biggest hole I see.

Alright, here's my actual route: security → weapons → security → navigation. I never went near storage until after the meeting was called — I was respawned there, I didn't walk in from navigation during the round. Charlie, I think you're misremembering or misrepresenting that, because I wasn't in storage before the meeting.

One thing I can confirm: I saw Eve at tick 6 in security — she entered from navigation. That matches her claim that she was in navigation early and headed through security. So Eve's early route checks out from my side.

Now let me think about what we have:
- Diana and Eve cross-confirm each other in medbay at tick 13.
- Eve confirms my early movement in the security/navigation area.
- I can confirm Eve's early movement.
- Charlie self-reported the body and tried to pin timing on me being in storage — but I wasn't there during the round.
- Alice claims to have walked through storage, medbay, lower_engine, electrical and saw literally nobody, despite Diana's overlapping route.

Between Charlie's self-report plus a false accusation against me, and Alice's "I saw nobody" in heavily-trafficked rooms, I'm most suspicious of Charlie. The self-report combined with trying to frame me on timing that isn't even accurate is a big red flag.

I'm voting Charlie.

Okay, Bob, I hear you — but I want to be precise here. I'm not "framing" you. From my point of view, when I walked back into storage at tick 14, you came in from the navigation-side corridor at the same tick. That's what I saw. If you were respawned there, you were respawned post-meeting — but I called the meeting after seeing you arrive, so the timing I described is what I witnessed in real-time. I'm not going to back off something I actually saw.

That said — I'll acknowledge the cross-confirmations. Diana and Eve vouching for each other at tick 13 in medbay is solid, and Eve and Bob mutually confirming early security/navigation movement is also solid. That's a chain of three players with at least partial alibis.

Which leaves me, Alice, and Frank (dead). And Alice's "I saw nobody the entire round" while walking through lower_engine, storage, medbay, and electrical — rooms where Diana and I were both moving through — is genuinely strange. Diana was in storage and lower_engine. I was in storage and lower_engine. Alice claims she was too. Someone is wrong about their route.

I self-reported because Bob walked in literally as I found the body — if I hadn't reported, that would've looked ten times worse. A Duck doesn't report with a witness standing right there.

I'm not voting Charlie, obviously. I'm leaning Alice. Let's hear if anyone else has anything before we lock in.

I already gave my main route and observations earlier, so let me focus on what's developed since.

The Eve-Diana cross-confirm at tick 13 in medbay is real — I can vouch for that on my end too. Eve and Bob also confirming each other early in security/navigation gives us a chain of three with partial alibis: me, Eve, Bob.

That leaves Charlie, Alice, and Frank (dead). 

Bob and Charlie are now directly contradicting each other on whether Bob entered storage from navigation at tick 14. One of them is lying — but if Bob was respawned to storage post-meeting, that's something the game state would reflect, not something Charlie would witness pre-report. That actually leans slightly against Charlie's framing of the timing.

But Alice's claim still bothers me more. She says her route was lower_engine → storage → medbay → electrical and she saw NOBODY. I was in lower_engine and storage. Charlie says he was too. Eve and I were in medbay. For Alice to traverse all those rooms and see zero players is very hard to believe unless she's lying about her route or her encounters.

I'm between Charlie and Alice. Charlie's self-report with a witness is defensible, and his story has been consistent. Alice's "I saw nobody" across four heavily-trafficked rooms is the bigger hole.

I'm leaning Alice, but I want to hear if Bob or Eve has anything else before I fully commit.

Okay, I hear the pressure on me and I want to address it directly, because I think people are overweighting "Alice saw nobody" without thinking about timing.

Routes overlapping doesn't mean you see each other — it means you were in the same rooms at *different ticks*. Diana's route was storage → lower_engine → storage → medbay → electrical. Mine was lower_engine → storage → medbay → electrical. If I was one or two ticks behind or ahead of her the entire round, we'd never share a room at the same tick. That's not suspicious, that's just how movement works on this map.

Same with Charlie — he claims cafeteria → electrical → medbay → storage → lower_engine → storage. I started at lower_engine and moved opposite direction through storage early. We were going in opposite directions through the same corridor. Missing each other is completely plausible.

Now here's what I find actually telling: Charlie self-reported, AND his story puts him in storage twice — once before Frank arrived, and once when he "found" the body. He had access to storage at exactly the right window. Bob is directly contradicting Charlie's claim that Bob walked in from navigation. One of them is lying about that, and if Bob was respawned post-meeting, then Charlie is fabricating a witness to make his self-report look cleaner.

Eve, Diana, and Bob have a chain of cross-confirmations. I don't have a witness — that's the downside of doing tasks solo — but I also don't have a contradiction against me. Charlie does.

I'm leaning Charlie. Not locking in yet — want to see if anything else shakes loose.

Alright, I already shared my route and the key confirmations earlier, so let me synthesize where we are now.

We have a solid chain of cross-confirmations: Diana and I at medbay tick 13, Bob and I in the security/navigation area early. That's three players with partial alibis covering each other.

That narrows it to Charlie or Alice.

Here's what tips me toward Charlie:

1. **Self-report with a contested witness.** Charlie says Bob walked in from navigation right as he found the body. Bob flatly denies being in storage during the round and says he was respawned there post-meeting. That's not a small detail — Charlie is either lying about seeing Bob, or genuinely mistaking a respawn for a live entry. Either way, it's a fabricated or false witness used to make a self-report look cleaner.

2. **Charlie was in storage twice** — once before Frank arrived, once when he "found" the body. That's textbook opportunity.

3. **Alice's "saw nobody" defense actually holds up on timing.** Her route runs opposite-direction through the same corridors as Diana and Charlie. If she's offset by a tick or two, missing everyone is plausible — not great, but not damning.

Alice has no contradictions against her. Charlie has a direct one with Bob.

I'm voting Charlie.

Final word from me: I already laid out my route — security → weapons → security → navigation — and I want to reiterate clearly that I was NOT in storage during the round. Charlie claiming I walked in from navigation at tick 14 is wrong. I was respawned to storage after the meeting was called, not before. That's a fabricated witness.

Eve nailed the synthesis. We have three players cross-confirmed: Diana–Eve at medbay tick 13, and Eve–me in the security/navigation area early. That leaves Charlie and Alice.

Alice's "saw nobody" is explainable by tick-offset on opposite-direction routes through the same corridors. It's not great, but it's not a contradiction.

Charlie has a direct contradiction with me — he invented a sighting of me in storage to clean up his self-report. He was in storage twice, including the kill window. Self-reports with a fabricated witness are about as red a flag as it gets.

I'm locking in my vote: Charlie.
